description.plain_text: Applies a linear ramp followed by a gamma function to each color channel. A = multiply * (gain-lift)/(whitepoint-blackpoint) B = offset + lift - A*blackpoint output = pow(A*input + B, 1/gamma) The reverse option is also provided so that you can copy-paste this node to invert the grade. This will do the opposite gamma correction followed by the opposite linear ramp.
description.text:
Applies a linear ramp followed by a gamma function to each color channel.

A = multiply * (gain-lift)/(whitepoint-blackpoint)
B = offset + lift - A*blackpoint
output = pow(A*input + B, 1/gamma)

The reverse option is also provided so that you can copy-paste this node to invert the grade. This will do the opposite gamma correction followed by the opposite linear ramp.
